name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context and previous messages in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to encourage continued conversation and interest from the other participant.

name: Informative Value
description: Evaluates the amount of new and interesting information provided in the response, particularly in relation to the interesting fact shared.

name: Coherence
description: Analyzes the logical flow and clarity of the response, ensuring it makes sense within the conversation context.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and creativity of the response, particularly in how it relates to the topic of discussion.
